nddeq-public-notices.how: Read the harvested index in scopes/us-nd/work/permits from harvest_permits.py: 298 notices and 248 saved permit documents in 94 folders, matched to GEM plants, with the 24 unmatched power-like facilities checked by hand.
nddeq-public-notices.found: Permits for all GEM plants with permits. The Applied Digital Ellendale backup fleets match GEM. Unmatched facilities are small emergency, peaking or industrial sources: Minnkota Colfax diesel engines, Hillsboro peaking engines, Basin's Bismarck emergency generator, Cavalier, Minot Air Force Base, AIC fuels and LM Wind. Crusoe's flare gas engines are portable sets under 50 MW per site. No new gas plant of 50 MW or more.

nddeq-notices-wayback.how: The harvester enumerated past notices through the Wayback Machine and read 113 saved copies of the notice page. On October 29, 2026 single addresses were also read from saved copies, such as the Colfax memo.
nddeq-notices-wayback.found: Past notices for Heskett, Spiritwood, Pioneer, Lonesome Creek, Bison, Coal Creek and the Applied Digital sites. Nothing new at 50 MW or more. Later direct lookups hit a 429 limit and then an outage, fetch.py returned a not found page for the old notice addresses, and the Wayback Machine lookup returned 429 and then was offline on October 29, 2026.

nddeq-general-notices.how: Read the general public notice list and the notice feed, both answering with 37 items, through the harvester.
nddeq-general-notices.found: No power plant or data center item beyond those on the air quality page.

ceris-nd.how: The harvester read the CERIS public notice list and the air site records: 14 air sites and 9 notices.
ceris-nd.found: Air site records for Bison, Heskett, Lonesome Creek, Pioneer, Spiritwood, Coal Creek, Coyote, Antelope Valley, Leland Olds, Young, the Hillsboro peak load generators, Basin's Bismarck emergency generator and LM Wind. No new gas plant.

psc-case-search.how: Used batches/us-nd/harvest/psc_dockets.md: case search by filing date from 2022, 13 entity names and 8 description words, plus 23 hand-checked cases, 2,140 cases with 415 about generation.
psc-case-search.found: PU-24-342 is Xcel's eastern North Dakota gas plant duty, not a Basin case, and now names the 447 MW Bison plant, added in this batch. PU-23-325 is Cerilon, raised as a question. PU-26-155 is Applied Digital's backup engines. PU-26-284 is the 200 MW Harmony battery. PU-25-086 is Basin's Bison Generation Station, already in GEM.

psc-webdocs.how: Read the documents of every gas case with pdftotext, including PU-24-342 entries 9, 11 and 16, PU-23-325 entries 1 and 67, and PU-26-155 entries 1.
psc-webdocs.found: The 447 MW Bison plant with a late 2032 service date, the Cerilon steam turbine units of 100 MW gross per phase, and Applied Digital's statement that similar backup engines would be used at its other North Dakota sites.

psc-siting.how: Read the siting page and its siting spreadsheet, 80 lines kept, through the harvester and again by fetch.py on October 29, 2026.
psc-siting.found: No letter of intent or certificate for a gas plant of 50 MW or more without a case number.

spp-queue.found: GEN-2024-081 and 082 are Basin's Bison plant, ERAS-2025-011 and 012 are River Run, GEN-2022-083, 010 and 009 are Pioneer, and GEN-2020-014 is Lonesome Creek. All are in GEM. No other gas or oil entry.

miso-queue.found: J3163 is Xcel's 481 MW Bison turbine, added in this batch at the 447 MW in Xcel's filing. S1036 is Great River Energy's 400 MW Discovery Wind project, not gas. eia-860m.found: Every gas or oil plant of 50 MW or more is in GEM. Bison is EIA plant 69071. The rest are under 50 MW or retired before 2020, listed under ids_followup.

eia-860.how: Read the 2025 annual Plant and Owner tables for North Dakota plants 2790, 56786, 57881, 57943 and 69071.
eia-860.found: Heskett at 2025 38th St, Mandan; Spiritwood at 3366 93rd Ave SE, Spiritwood; Pioneer at 5639 151st Ave NW, Williston; Lonesome Creek at 2648 140th Ave NW, Alexander; Bison at 6261 121st Ave NW, Ray. basin-electric.found: Dates, sizes and turbine details for Basin's plants, all already in GEM. No new Basin gas plant in North Dakota.

possible-updates-sheet.how: Read the gas/oil plants tab through the work Google profile on October 29, 2026; two North Dakota rows.
possible-updates-sheet.found: The River Run row from December 2025 is done. us-nd:new:xcel-bison-generating-station.evidence: The name match is Basin Electric's Bison Generation Station in Williams County, about 500 kilometers away. It has another owner and is a separate project. The nearby GEM plant is Minnkota Power's Cass power station, 2.8 kilometers away and also planned for Harmony Township. Minnkota is a different utility, and its plant was announced in October 2026 at 400 MW. This record is Xcel's 447 MW bid in Public Service Commission case PU-24-342 and MISO request J3163, which Northern States Power filed.
